note: Curated sample Ghana property/development listings for the Gabochie Marketplace MVP. Prices in GHS, sizes in m2. These are illustrative market data points, not live offers.

listings.title: 4-Bedroom Luxury Villa, East Legon (Greenwich Area)
listings.excerpt: Freehold 4-bedroom villa in East Legon's quiet Greenwich enclave with a private pool and 2-car garage.
listings.content:
Recently finished luxury villa in the sought-after Greenwich area of East Legon. Full freehold title, 4 ensuite bedrooms, study, family room, pool and landscaped compound.

Ideal for a diaspora buyer looking for a turnkey home in a gated, quiet neighbourhood near the airport corridor.

listings.title: 3-Bedroom Apartment, Cantonments
listings.excerpt: Serviced 3-bedroom apartment in Cantonments with central AC, gym and 24/7 security.
listings.content: Top-floor serviced apartment in a managed Cantonments development. Open-plan living, 3 ensuite bedrooms, dedicated parking and building-wide amenities.

listings.title: Penthouse with Skyline View — Adenta
listings.excerpt: Freshly furnished penthouse to rent in Adenta with mountain views and private terrace.
listings.content: Bright, furnished penthouse in a young Adenta development. Large terrace, modern kitchen and lift access.

listings.title: Ready Plot of Land with Title — Legon
listings.excerpt: Registered plot in Legon with clean title, suitable for a 3-bedroom build or investment hold.
listings.content:
Serviced and registered plot in a documented Legon corner with access roads and utilities at the boundary. Clean title available for transfer.

A strong candidate for build-to-hold or a quick resale in a liquid corridor.

listings.title: Beach-Access Land — Sakumono (Tema Corridor)
listings.excerpt: Beach-adjacent parcel near the Tema corridor, zoned residential with strong rental fundamentals.
listings.content: Chunk of land with direct access to the beach area, minutes from the Tema motorway. Good for a holiday house or a small residential development.

listings.title: Retail Unit, Adum Commercial District — Kumasi
listings.excerpt: Prime ground-floor retail unit in Kumasi's busiest commercial street, currently yielding.
listings.content: Level retail space in Adum with high footfall, fitted with a mezzanine and storage. Currently tenanted on a rolling commercial lease.

listings.title: Warehouse with Yard — Tema Industrial Area
listings.excerpt: Heavy-duty warehouse and yard in Tema with 3-phase power and container access.
listings.content: Large industrial warehouse with secure yard, high clearance and easy container access in the Tema free-zone corridor.

listings.title: Off-Plan Villa — Dansoman (Completion 12 Months)
listings.excerpt: Buy off-plan a 4-bedroom villa in Dansoman with staged payments matched to build milestones.
listings.content: Off-plan 4-bedroom villa with an estimated 12-month completion. Pricing is staged to the build: 30% on signing, then milestone payments, balance on handover.

listings.title: Development Site — Trassaco Valley
listings.excerpt: Master-plan-approving hillside site in Trassaco Valley for a small gated community build.
listings.content: Hillside parcel in Trassaco Valley suitable for a 8–12 unit gated community or premium family houses. Board approvals progressing; utilities nearby.

listings.title: Apartment-Block Plot — Spintex Road
listings.excerpt: Corner plot on the busy Spintex corridor, zoned for compact apartment development.
listings.content: Corner development plot with road frontage on the Spintex corridor, ideal for a compact serviced-apartment or office block with strong rental demand.

listings.title: Beach House Retreat — Takoradi
listings.excerpt: Seafront 3-bedroom house in Takoradi with stone terraces and west-facing sunsets.
listings.content: Seafront retreat with open plan living opening onto a shaded terrace. Established garden and a small staff cottage on site.

listings.title: New Townhouse in Gated Community — Trassaco
listings.excerpt: Recently completed three-level townhouse in a managed Trassaco Valley gated estate.
listings.content: Three-storey townhouse in a secure managed estate with borehole water, compound power and common gardens.

listings.title: Duplex — Oshiemi Off-Plan
listings.excerpt: Semi-detached duplex in the Oshiemi growth corridor, estimated 10-month completion.
listings.content: Off-plan semi-detached duplex in an emerging Accra growth node. Flexible finishes and a staged payment schedule.

listings.title: Investment Land — Dodowa (Greater Accra Periphery)
listings.excerpt: Perimeter land in the Dodowa growth corridor, a value hold with rising infrastructure adjacency.

listings.title: Beachfront Apartment — Cape Coast
listings.excerpt: Furnished 2-bedroom apartment with ocean views near Cape Coast Castle.
listings.content: Bright furnished apartment minutes from Cape Coast Castle with sea views, ideal for a remote-work stay or annual rental.
